title: CORNDON Korean Gangnam (K-Punch)
body_html:
Korean Gangnam packs bold Korean street-food flavors into every crunchy bite. Fiery, savory, and full of umami, these popped corn chips are never baked or fried. Gluten-free, with no trans fat and no palm oil, they're the perfect snack for spice lovers who crave big flavor and light crunch.

Ingredients: Corn (76%), Edible Vegetable Oil (Rice Bran), Seasoning [Sugar, Maltodextrin, Iodized Salt, Dehydrated Vegetable Powders & Extracts (Garlic, Lime, Onion), Spices and Spice Extracts (Chilli, Black Pepper, Celery), Corn Starch, Acidity Regulator (INS 330), Skimmed Milk Powder, Flavour Enhancer (INS 627, INS 631), Paprika Oleoresin (INS 160c), Yeast Extract], Emulsifier (INS 322), Rosemary Extract (INS 392).

title: CORNDON Don's BBQ
body_html:
Don's BBQ delivers smoky, savory barbecue flavor with a tangy twist in every crunchy bite. These popped corn chips are never baked or fried, offering a light, irresistible crunch. Gluten-free, with no trans fat and no palm oil, they're made for bold snack lovers who crave authentic BBQ goodness.

Ingredients: Corn (74%), Edible Vegetable Oil (Rice Bran Oil), Seasoning [Maltodextrin, Sugar, Iodized Salt, Honey Powder, Dehydrated Vegetable Powders & Extracts (Garlic, Onion), Spices and Spice Extracts (Coriander, Cumin, Ginger), Hydrolysed Vegetable Protein (Soya Base), Acidity Regulator (INS 330), Anticaking Agent (INS 341(iii), INS 551), Flavour Enhancer (INS 627, INS 631), Yeast Extract, Paprika Oleoresin (INS 160c)], Emulsifier (INS 322), Rosemary Extract (INS 392).

title: CORNDON Truffle Undercover
body_html:
Truffle Undercover blends rich truffle aroma with deep umami flavor for a gourmet snacking experience. These popped corn chips are never baked or fried, delivering light, crispy crunch. Gluten-free, with no trans fat and no palm oil, every bite is indulgent, sophisticated, and irresistibly satisfying.

Ingredients: Corn (78%), Edible Vegetable Oil (Rice Bran), Seasoning [Glucose Syrup Powder, Iodized Salt, Maltodextrin, Dried Garlic Powder, Edible Vegetable Oil (Olive Oil), Anti Caking Agent (INS 551), Thickening Agent (INS 1450)], Emulsifier (INS 322), Rosemary Extract (INS 392).

title: Salted Peanuts (Pack of 10)
body_html:
Salted Peanuts pair premium roasted peanuts with the pure, balanced taste of Himalayan pink salt. Every crunchy bite delivers clean, natural flavor without overpowering spices. Simple, wholesome, and satisfying, they're the perfect everyday snack for any time, anywhere.

Ingredients: Peanut (96.5%), Edible Vegetable Oil (Palmolein, Cotton Seed, Rice Bran), Edible Iodised Salt (1%).

title: Piri Piri Peanuts (Pack of 10)
body_html:
Piri Piri Peanuts combine premium roasted peanuts with fiery piri piri seasoning for the perfect balance of spice, tanginess, and smoky flavor. Bold, crunchy, and packed with personality, they're the ultimate snack for adventurous taste buds craving an exciting kick in every bite.

Ingredients: Peanut (89%), Edible Vegetable Oil (Palmolein, Cotton Seed, Rice Bran), Spices & Condiments [(Red Chilli, Dried Onion, Dried Garlic, Carom Seeds, Cumin, Nutmeg, Mace, Black Pepper Powder), Salt, Maltodextrin, Tamarind Powder, Oregano, Acidity Regulator (INS 330) & (INS 296), Paprika Extract (INS 160c), Flavour Enhancer (INS 627) & (INS 631), Anti-Caking Agent (INS 551)].

title: Heeng Jeera Peanuts (Pack of 10)
body_html:
Heeng Jeera Peanuts bring together the nostalgic flavors of hing and cumin with perfectly roasted peanuts. Every crunchy bite delivers authentic Indian taste and comforting spice. Rich, flavorful, and satisfying, they're the perfect snack for chai breaks, travel, or anytime cravings strike.

Ingredients: Peanut (89%), Edible Vegetable Oil (Palmolein, Cotton Seed, Rice Bran), Spices & Condiments [(Red Chilli, Cumin (2.8%), Clove), Asafoetida, Salt, Maltodextrin, Sugar, Acidity Regulator (INS 330) (INS 260) & (INS 296), Paprika Extract (INS 160c), Flavour Enhancer (INS 627) & (INS 631)].

title: MR. MAKHANA Gourmet Truffle
body_html:
The black-tie of snacking. Earthy black truffle meets light, crunchy lotus seeds for an instant umami upgrade. Luxe taste, zero heaviness. Gluten-free, plant-based, binge-worthy.

Makhana (Popped Lotus Seeds) 70%, Olive Oil 20%, Spices & Condiments 10% (Spices, Glucose Syrup Powder, Salt, Maltodextrin, Vegetable Oil (Sunflower), Anti-Caking Agent (Silicon Dioxide E551), Thickening Agent (Starch Sodium Octenyl Succinate E1450), Triacetine E-1518

title: Veda
body_html:
Pure, natural, and minimally processed, our Veda Raw Makhana brings you the wholesome goodness of foxnuts in their cleanest form. Packed with plant-based protein, fiber, and essential minerals, it’s a versatile superfood made for mindful snacking and healthy living. Light, nourishing, and 100% authentic because great ingredients need no extras.

Makhana/Foxnut/ Gorgon Nut/Popped Lotus Seed

title: Pudina Party
body_html:
Fresh, herby, and full of life, our Pudina Party Makhana brings together the crispness of roasted makhana with the cool, tangy notes of classic pudina masala. Roasted in olive oil and seasoned to perfection, it’s gluten-free, antioxidant-rich, and light enough to keep you snacking without the slowdown. A refreshing spin for those who like their crunch with a twist.

Makhana (Popped Lotus Seeds) 70%, Olive Oil 18%, Spices & Condiments 10% (Dried Ginger, Dried Mango, Dried Garlic, Green Chilli, Coriander Leaves, Cumin, Cardamom, Turmeric, Fennel, Black Pepper, Clove, Nutmeg. Mace, Carom Seeds), Salt, Sugar, Lemon Powder, Mint Leaves, Maltodextrin, Acidity Regulator (Citric acid E330), Flavour Enhancer (Disodium 5'-ribonucleotides E635).

title: Sea Salt & Vinegar
body_html:
Our Sea Salt & Vinegar Makhana takes the classic tangy zing you love and pairs it with the lightest, crunchiest popped makhanas, roasted to perfection in olive oil.
Guilt-free, gluten-free, and antioxidant-rich, this snack hits that perfect spot between tart, savory, and totally addictive.

Makhana (Popped Lotus Seeds) 75%, Olive Oil 18%, Salt, Sugar, Edible Starch, Maltodextrin, Aciidity Regulators (E330 and E334), Sodium Salt [E262(ii)], Hydrolysed Vegetable Protein, Spices and Spice Extract (Black Pepper), Anti Caking Agents [E551 and E341(ii)], Soy Sauce powder, Flavour Enhancer [E627 and E631]

title: Piri Piri Paradise
body_html:
A bold mix of spice and zest, our Piri Piri Paradise Makhana is made for those who like their snacks with a little fire. Roasted in olive oil and coated with a balanced blend of Piri Piri seasoning, it brings just the right amount of heat without overpowering the natural lightness of makhana. Gluten-free, antioxidant-rich, and full of honest flavour, it's a snack that stays with you.

[Ammonium Chloride E510], Colour [Paprika oleoresin E160c], Flavour Enhancer (Disodium 5'-ribonucleotides E635)

title: Pickle Tickle
body_html:
Tangy, spicy, and irresistibly bold - our Pickle Tickle Makhana brings the classic Indian achaar magic to your snack time. Roasted in olive oil and packed with the boldness of pickling spices, it’s gluten-free, antioxidant-rich, and zero cholesterol. Perfect for when you crave that chatpata twist without the guilt.

Makhana (Popped Lotus Seeds) 68%, Olive Oil 18%, Spices & Condiments 12% (Salt, Fennel, Red Chilly, Fenugreek Leaves, Fenugreek Seeds, Cumin, Turmeric), Sugar, Maltodextrin, Mustard Seeds, Acidity Regulator (E330), Flavour Enhancer (E627), (E631)

title: Lime & Chilli
body_html:
For those who like a little mischief in every bite, our Lime & Chilli Makhana brings the perfect kick of spice with a zing of mint to keep things interesting. Roasted in olive oil and packed with bold masalas, it’s crunchy, fiery, and full of flavour that doesn’t hold back. Light on guilt, loud on taste, it’s the snack that refuses to be ignored.

Makhana (Popped Lotus Seeds) 70%,Ollive Oil 18%, Spices & Condiments 10% (Dried Garlic, Dried Ginger, Dried Mango, Dried Onion, Red Chilli, Green Chilli, Coriander Leaves, Turmeric, Cumin, Black Pepper, Nutmeg, Mace), Salt, Sugar, Maltodextrin, Acidity Regulator [Citric acid E330), Flavour Enhancer [Disodium 5'-ribonucleotides E635]

title: Himalayan Salt & Pepper
body_html:
Simple, timeless, and perfectly balanced - our Himalayan Salt & Pepper Makhana brings a bold, earthy punch with every crunchy bite. Roasted in olive oil and seasoned with premium Himalayan salt and cracked black pepper, it's gluten-free, antioxidant-rich, and zero cholesterol. Light enough to munch anytime, bold enough to crave every time.

Makhana (Popped Lotus Seeds) 70%, Olive Oil 18% Pink Salt (Rock Salt), Black Pepper, Milk Solids, Maltodextrin, Hydrolyse Peanut Protein, Flavour Enhancer (Disodium 5'- ribonucleotides E635)

title: Cream and Onion
body_html:
Smooth, savory, and full of classic comfort, our Cream & Onion Makhana brings together the rich creaminess and subtle onion kick you crave. Roasted lightly in olive oil, it offers a melt-in-mouth start with a sharp, tangy finish — all while staying gluten-free, antioxidant-rich, and zero cholesterol. Big on flavour, light on guilt — the perfect snack for any mood.

Makhana (Popped Lotus Seeds) 70%, Olive Oil 18%, Spices & Condiments 10% (Dried White Onion, Parshlay, Chilli) Edible Salt, Sugar, Whey Powder, Milk Solid, Hydrolysed Peanut Protein, Acidity Regulator (Malic acid E296), Cheese Concentrate, Butter Concentrate, Maltodextrin, Flavour Enhancer (Disodium 5'- ribonucleotides E635), Ammonium Chloride (E510).

title: Cheezypeezy
body_html:
Light, crunchy, and loaded with cheesy goodness - our Cheezy Peezy Makhana brings the drama without the guilt. Roasted in olive oil and packed with a creamy punch, it’s gluten-free, antioxidant-rich, and zero cholesterol. The perfect snack when you want a cheesy twist that’s still light as air.

Makhana (Popped Lotus Seeds) 68%, Olive Oil 18%, Seasoning & Condiments 12% [Wheat Flour, Spices condiments, Yellow Chilli, Onion, Garlic, Oregano, Salt, Sugar, Milk Solids, Maltodextrin, Hydrolysed Vegetable Proteins (Peanut), Acidity Regulator (E296), Flavour Enhancer (E627)(E631), Colour (E160c)]

title: Butter Tomato
body_html:
Smooth, tangy, and packed with comfort, our Butter Tomato Makhana pairs the richness of butter with the lively bite of tomato. Lightly roasted in olive oil and seasoned for a balanced burst of flavor, it’s gluten-free, antioxidant-rich, and designed for everyday snacking. A familiar taste, reimagined in every light, crunchy bite.

Makhana (Popped Lotus Seeds)70%, Olive Oil 18%, Spices & Condiments 10% (Red Chilli, Dried Onion Flakes, Cerinder Seeds, Fennel, Black Pepper, Mace) Salt, Tomato Powder, Maltodextrin, Nausadar(Ammonium Chloride) (E510), Butter Concentrate, Acidity Regulator (Citric acid E330) & (Malic acid E296), Hydrolyse Peanut Protein, Colour (Paprika oleoresin E 160c), Flavour Enhancer (Disodium 5'- ribonucleotides E6351)

title: Black Salt
body_html:
Simple yet satisfying, our Black Salt Makhana brings a classic desi twist to light, crunchy snacking. Roasted in olive oil and seasoned with mineral-rich black salt, it’s a clean, earthy flavor that feels familiar but refreshing. Gluten-free, antioxidant-rich, and full of honest goodness - perfect for when you want something fuss-free yet flavourful.

Makhana (Popped Lotus Seeds) 75% Olive Oil 10%, Maltadextrin, Black Salt, Acidity Regulators [E330 and E334], Anti Caking Agents [E551 and [E341())

title: MR. MAKHANA Nut Shack Home Style Salted Roasted Cashews 200 g
body_html:
Old-school, but never boring.
Our Home Style Salted Cashews keep it classic with a clean roast and just the right hit of salt, no fancy business, just pure snack discipline. For days when you want real flavour without the drama, grab a handful, and get on with life.

Cashew Nuts (99%), Edible lodized Salt (1%)

title: MR. MAKHANA Nut Shack Desi Masala Roasted Cashews 200 g
body_html:
Who said cashews had to play it safe? Our Desi Masala Cashews bring the spice, the drama, and all the snack-worthy chaos your taste buds deserve. Roasted, not fried, and seasoned with a punchy mix of Indian spices, it’s the kind of snack that doesn't just sit quietly - it shows up and takes over.

Cashew Nuts (90%), Spices & Condiments (10%) (Black Pepper, Dried Mango Powder, Red Chilli, Edible Common Salt, Black Salt, Spices Powder & Spice Extract (Coriander, Cumin, Dry Ginger, Star anise, Bay Leaf, Long Pepper, Cinnamon, Black Cardamom, Nutmeg, Mace)

title: Mr. Makhana Trail Mix 30 GM
body_html:
Small pack. Big balance.
A neat mix of roasted almonds, cranberries, seeds, and raisins, made to fit into your everyday hustle. Light, nutrient-rich, and easy to carry, it’s your no-drama daily snack that simply gets the job done, whether you’re working, commuting, or just need a mid-day fix.

Roasted Almonds (27%), Cranberries (20%), Pumpkin Seeds (18%), Black Resin (20%), Sunflower Seeds (15%)

title: Mr. Makhana ChocoPop Resealable Pouch 65 GM
body_html:
A harmonious blend of light, roasted makhana and rich cocoa. Our Chocopop offers a balanced taste profile, subtle sweetness with a satisfying crunch. Crafted without added preservatives and roasted in olive oil, it's a thoughtful choice for those seeking a refined snacking experience.

Makhana (Fox Nuts) 45%, Sugar, Cocoa Powder (16%), Milk Solids, Edible Vegetable Oil (Sunflower Oil), Himalayan Rock Salt, Vanilla Flavour

title: Mr. Makhana Classic Bhel 57 GM
body_html:
Not your average bhel.
We tossed together roasted makhana, puffed rice, peanuts, and crunchy multigrain chips to create a snack that's light on your belly but loud on flavour. Sweet here, tangy there and totally ready for your mood swings. Just open, mix, and let the snacking chaos begin.

Bhel Mix 86% (Roasted Makhana/Popped Lotus Seeds, Puffed Rice, Peanuts, Extruded Chips [Jowar Flour, Rice Flour, Maize Flour, Tapioca Starch, Potato Powder, Chickpea Flour], Edible Vegetable Oil (Sunflower Oil) 7%, Spices and Condiments 7% (Sugar, Salt, Black Salt, Onion, Dry Mango, Turmeric, Coriander, Tomato Powder, Corn Starch, Maltodextrin, Black Pepper, Garlic, Cumin, Red Chilli, Fenugreek seed, Acidity Regulator (E330) and Antioxidant (E319)
